items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: So if somebody asked for a Gershwin tune, the Wolverines played China Boy.

ctx.x: Uh, did they ever get to the point, well, this, I, uh, is a loaded question. Uh, where they, it became, uh, rhythmically monotonous. Now, the rock and roll, uh, calls for a very pronounced beat. And it can be a 4-4 or 2-4. And, uh, after a while, you kind of wish it would ever.

Well, there's something in the nature of the tunes they were playing. I mentioned China Boy, for instance. Uh, the Wolverines used to play it quite a lot because that was a standard tune they played when, uh, they were requested to play something they didn't know. Oh. If somebody, uh, it was very fashionable. Uh, it took six months for a show tune to get from New York to Chicago. Uh-huh. At that stage. And anybody who'd been in New York was very proud of being from New York. So they would always request the show…
